_note: Parameters for grade.py apply(). target describes the GRADED result on 0-100 (the scale of bashcut color measure and grade.py measure): ref = the fitted reference value, range = [low, high] that still reads as this look (null = open end), why = what the range means and its source. Ranges are readings for the agent, not corrections: grade.py applies nothing that is not in params or passed on the command line. Tints are [R-B, G-(R+B)/2]; a tint range is one per component.

matte-cinematic.description: Matte cinematic: lifted (matte) blacks, highlights rolled off near 84, slightly teal shadows, warm mids, peach highlights, low saturation (~28). Greens shift to olive, sky desaturated, skin kept. Good default for street, daytime and travel footage.
matte-cinematic.fitted: Fitted on Rec709 (normal profile) phone and drone footage against reference shots; ref = median of those shots.

black.why: matte: lifted blacks, 4-9 (#475); black > 3 reads as matte (style-study, T15 §3); reference 7 (T12 §3)

mid.why: daylight vlog mid luma ~30-50; lower on purpose for night, low-key and silhouettes (T12 §3, §7)

tint_shadow.why: teal shadows: R-B < 0 with highlight R-B > 0 reads as teal-orange (style-study, T15 §3)

warm-film.description: Warm film: warm yellow across the frame, deep blacks, highlights compressed to ~66-76, saturation ~29, a touch of green. For warm indoor light, late afternoon and personal stories.
warm-film.fitted: Fitted on Rec709 (normal profile) phone and drone footage against reference shots; ref = median of those shots.

black.why: deep blacks: not matte, black <= 3 (style-study, T15 §3); reference 2.6

mid.why: daylight vlog mid luma ~30-50; lower on purpose for night, low-key and silhouettes (T12 §3, §7); reference 31.2 sits at the low end

tint_mid.why: warm yellow with a touch of green (look description): R-B > 0, G-M > 0

tint_high.why: warm yellow with a touch of green (look description): R-B > 0, G-M > 0

faded-memory.description: Faded memory: near black-and-white (sat 0.12), lifted blacks, rolled-off whites. For a hook, a flashback or an emotional low point; return to colour afterwards.
faded-memory.fitted: No reference spread recorded: only a saturation reference.

black.why: lifted blacks: black > 3 reads as matte (style-study, T15 §3)
